description:
PL/SQL development experience with Java backend is needed
 

 * Please write on resume where candidate is interested in Charlotte or SLC location or both *
 

 Are you a Software Engineer interested in working in a fast paced Health Informatics team? Do you want to create world class software that directly impacts patient care? Premier’s Safety Solutions group is the industry leader in clinical surveillance software that prevents bad outcomes and drives world class patient care. Our Theradoc® platform is continuing to push the envelope and solve big problems facing clinicians in hospitals across the country. We need an experienced Software Engineer to lead a team to develop high performing software in a complex and agile business environment.
 

 The Database Developer will work on our Safety team and can sit in our Salt Lake City, UT office or our Headquarters in Charlotte, NC.
 

 Key Accountabilities:
 

 • Writes code and assists in development of new products and enhances and maintains existing products
 

 • Commitment to proof of concept of new open source technologies
 

 • Analyzes and addresses requirements in product design
 

 • Estimates work effort
 

 • Creates and executes unit test cases (both automated and manual)
 

 • Participate in software and architectural software development activities
 

 • Drive best practice, quality and consistency within design and development phases
 

 • Provides support to resolve customer issues, perform debugging, and create patches
 

 • Constant collaboration with the software release team
 

 Required Qualifications:
 

 • 3-5 years’ experience in software development using Oracle
 

 • Expertise in complex PL/SQL for software engineering in a high speed, transactional application
 

 • Experience in performance engineering through database management and query tuning
 

 • Experience with web based service architecture and application development
 

 • Experience with unit test methodologies and tools
 

 • Strong ability to identify, analyze, and solve problems
 

 • Self-starter that can drive work to completion with high quality
 

 • Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment
 

 • Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks
 

 • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field


 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS 
 
  6 Months Contract after Hire 
 ONLY GC AND USC
